title: Relative Molecular Mass & Gram Mole
notes:
Relative Molecular Mass & Gram Mole

Sum of atomic masses of all constituent atoms.
• Glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆) = 180 amu
• Sucrose (C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁) = 342 amu
• H₂SO₄ = 98 amu
No. of gram moles = Given weight (g) ÷ Molecular mass.
